usageNote: 口语短语！spend time doing就是'把时间花在做某事上'，带点抱怨或强调的语气，超常用！

examples.en: I could spend all the time telling you what to do, but you need to figure it out yourself.
examples.zh: 我可以一直告诉你该怎么做，但你得自己想明白。

examples.en: She spends all the time telling you how great her life is.
examples.zh: 她整天跟你说她的生活有多好。
